note: the card is bound to the node's gate state: the decision UI only for a genuinely submitted gate, a stale click refused before it writes, a next line on every card, and a self-refreshing view

claims.statement: the decision UI is rendered only when the addressed gate's state is submitted (read from the card's own /api/confirm); otherwise it is ABSENT and the card states the truth (already confirmed on <date> / no undecided gate)

every card carries a next line derived from status + gate states (queued and not submitted · entry confirmed, work not started · work in progress · waiting on a decision naming the gate · accepted, awaiting complete! · closed), so a queued task never looks decidable
decide() re-reads the node before the write and refuses locally when the gate is no longer submitted (stale — nothing was written), so the auto-submit path of gate! cannot be reached by a stale click
the view refreshes on window focus / visibility change and via an explicit Refresh control with an as-of timestamp, so an external decision cannot leave it silently stale
634 tests / 37 files green (the served-page assertions cover the state-truth guards), typecheck clean, ann check + ann verify clean
